name: Snake River Farms
description: Premium American Wagyu beef and Kurobuta pork brand (part of Agri Beef, founded 1968). Its own affiliates page publishes a 10% commission on all sales with a 30-day cookie, product review opportunities, monthly sales incentives and dedicated affiliate managers, and its signup routes to Impact; the page explicitly recruits content creators ('We are looking for content creators to share about our delicious Wagyu Beef'). Older directory listings citing 7% via ShareASale appear to predate the current Impact terms and are documented as a conflict. No cap statement or creator count is published, so cap and saturation are unknown.

evidence.summary: Snake River Farms' own affiliates page, fetched in full: '10% Commission,' '30 Day Cookie Duration,' product review opportunities, monthly sales incentives and dedicated affiliate managers; '10% commission paid on all sales'; the 'Sign up now!' link routes to app.impact.com, confirming the Impact network; and the FAQ states 'We are looking for content creators to share about our delicious Wagyu Beef, Kurobuta Pork, and more.' No cap statement or creator count is published, so cap and saturation stay unknown.

LinkClicky lists Snake River Farms on Impact at 10% per sale ('just what's officially listed with their affiliate program'), corroborating the brand's own page. Older listings (Lasso and ShareASale roundups) cite 7% with a 60-day cookie via ShareASale, which conflicts with the current own-page/Impact terms and is documented here as a superseded route.

reasons.contact_access: Dedicated affiliate managers are published on the brand's own page, though no public partnerships email was found.

reasons.credibility: Heritage brand founded in 1968 (Agri Beef), featured on Michelin-starred menus per its own page, with terms published on its own domain.

description: Daily greens gummy supplement brand. Trade-press coverage of its agency (T-Bar Partners) documents a large TikTok Shop affiliate program: free samples with creative briefs, post-count contests with cash prizes, and retainers for top sellers. The brand's own referral page separately pays a flat $20 for every referral plus product rewards via a personal link. No TikTok Shop percentage is published in the fetched sources, so commission_rate is null with the flat referral documented. No cap statement and no absolute creator count are published (coverage implies thousands of creator videos, which is scale, not low saturation), so cap and saturation are unknown.

evidence.summary: Grüns' own referral program page, fetched in full: 'Join the Grüns referral program! Earn product rewards and $20 for every single referral. It's as easy as sharing your personal link!' The page notes the program is 'designed for personal, unpaid referrals only' and that paid-ad arbitrage commissions are not honored. The $20 is a flat per-referral amount, not a percentage, so commission_rate is null. No cap statement or creator count is published.

Trade-press account of a Commerce Roundtable talk by T-Bar Partners, the agency running Grüns' TikTok Shop affiliate program: creators receive free samples with a creative brief and Discord access, contests pay cash for post count (first place $3,000, second $2,000, plus a top-seller prize), and strong sellers are offered retainers; the agency describes shipping roughly 500 samples per month across its brands and aiming for at least three videos per sample. This documents an active, structured TikTok Shop creator program at scale — no commission percentage or absolute creator count for Grüns is published.
